phrase: One AI company now bans users from being cruel to its chatbot. Another was revealed to have revenue twenty billion dollars smaller than earlier reports claimed.
phraseAlternatives: A chatbot just got protection from abusive users. Its maker's bank account did not get the same protection from reality.
Some companies protect their robots from cruelty. Other companies get caught by reports on where twenty billion dollars went missing.
Be kind to the chatbot, one company said today. Investors just learned the revenue numbers were kinder than the real ones.
alt: On the left, a speech bubble labeled SAFE wears a small yellow shield badge, floating clearly above a worried person whose raised fist stops well short of it, open blue space between them. On the right, a hand erases the top of a short bar chart down from a dotted line marking its old, taller height, with a label reading minus twenty billion dollars.

brief.concept: One AI company shields its chatbot from angry users, while nearby a company's own revenue chart quietly gets erased down to a smaller, truer size.
brief.metaphor: Protecting feelings is easy; protecting numbers from reality is not.

brief.composition: Left half: a speech bubble with a small shield icon on its surface, a human fist pulled back just short of touching it, suggesting a new rule stopped it. Right half: a tall bar chart on the blueprint grid, a hand mid-erase shrinking its top down to a shorter bar, with a dotted line and small yellow highlight marking where the old, taller height used to be.
brief.alt: On one side, a chatbot speech bubble wears a small shield that stops an angry fist. On the other side, a hand erases the top of a tall bar chart down to a much shorter bar, with a dotted line showing where the taller bar used to reach.
